'''Apple cinnamon oatmeal''' is a breakfast bowl that heals {{Hp|10}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for 10 minutes and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 2 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/oatmeal.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, a [[milk bottle]], estus ash, a raw [[apple]], 2 [[wheat grain]] and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a bowl unlocks the recipe, and crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|10}} and gives Speed I (+20%) for 10:00 and Regeneration I for 2:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
